metadata.api_config: one Uvicorn process, default thread/BLAS settings and access logs; loopback HTTP
metadata.cpu_convention: 100% = one CPU core; host quota is cpu.max quota/period
metadata.sampling: API process /proc every 100 ms; Linux VmHWM; per-container cgroup CPU and memory.peak
metadata.latency: monotonic request start through full response body; closed-loop zero think time
